sector-education: This sector covers investment in learning places and in projects that build people up: schools and colleges, programmes for people with special needs and for children with autism, and work that grows knowledge and human development.
It also covers the management and organising work that keeps those places running well.
sector-sustainability: We help build the hardware, software, cloud, data and analytics skills needed to use safe, smart, secure and sustainable technology, with a focus on micro, small and medium economies.

Rural and underserved communities come first, through village care and village adoption programmes. We work with government schemes, development programmes and charitable foundations to widen access to education and to reduce poverty.
sector-space: This sector covers holding companies that invest in, own and manage ventures working on space-related activity, using home or foreign capital.
sector-commercial: This sector covers holding companies that invest in, own and manage businesses in trade, transport, contracting and finance.
sector-agriculture: This sector covers holding companies that own and manage farming businesses: land reclamation, animal and poultry farming, marketing of crops, and the use of fish and other sea resources.
sector-sport: This sector covers holding companies that own, run and manage sports infrastructure and sports projects.
sector-health-tech: This sector covers holding companies that set up and manage technology ventures in life sciences and healthcare, the environment, digital technology and artificial intelligence.
sector-msme: Small businesses create jobs and support both the economy and society, and they must stay agile and profitable. New technology is making many old processes obsolete, and large firms are leaning on automation to cut headcount. Skill gaps follow.
So small businesses need to build upskilling and reskilling into the way they work. We connect education providers, skills, workers, certifiers and employers in one joined-up approach.
sector-energy-ict: This sector covers holding companies that set up and manage technology ventures in information and communications technology, energy and renewable energy, the environment, digital technology and artificial intelligence.
sector-industry: This sector covers holding companies that own and manage industrial, extraction and converting businesses.
sector-energy-fuels: This sector covers holding companies that own and manage oil and natural gas projects and run them in an operating role.
sector-water: This sector covers holding companies that own and manage water infrastructure and water projects and run them in an operating role.
